As with system availability, the solution SHALL provide dashboards of performance Performance/ DDCC.NFXNREQ.025 metrics, allow querying of the performance log and export of performance data for response time reports. Tools to request an account, log in, log out, set and change passwords, and receive DDCC.NFXNREQ.027 Security and privacy password reminders SHALL be provided. All interactions between a client and a server component of the solution SHALL be DDCC.NFXNREQ.028 Security and privacy securely encrypted to prevent “man in the middle” interference with data in transit.
